svg.aria-label: About: Full-stack developer owning products end to end within the modern TypeScript ecosystem. End-to-end delivery: taking features from design mockup to production — UI, API, database and infrastructure. Web & Mobile: building web apps and cross-platform mobile apps backed by reusable design systems. Backend & Integrations: designing modular services, webhook integrations and solid relational data models. Snapshot: Experience: Since 2023; Education: M.S. in CS · NURE (2025); Location: Kharkiv, UA (Remote); Languages: UA native · EN B1; Focus: Full-Stack & Mobile Stack: Core: TypeScript, JavaScript; Web & Mobile: Next.js, React, React Native, Expo, Tailwind; Backend: NestJS, Elysia.js, Node.js, Express; Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma, Drizzle; Cloud & Infra: AWS (S3/CloudFront), Docker, CI/CD Mindset: Turning ambitious, visually-refined designs into fluid digital products. Deconstructing complex problems into clean, reusable primitives. Obsessing over performance and resilience — from interface to cloud.
